def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate the solid separator row or column.
    row_sep = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    if row_sep is not None:
        first, second = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep+1:]
    else:
        col_sep = next(j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1)
        first = [[grid[i][j] for j in range(col_sep)] for i in range(h)]
        second = [[grid[i][j] for j in range(col_sep+1, w)] for i in range(h)]
    shared = set(v for row in first for v in row) & set(v for row in second for v in row)
    bg = min(shared)
    return [[3 if a == b else bg for a, b in zip(r1, r2)] for r1, r2 in zip(first, second)]
